title: Strong and Weak-Type Dispersive Estimates for the Energy-Critical Nonlinear Schrödinger Equation with an Inverse-Square Potential
summary: We prove dispersive estimates for the three-dimensional defocusing energy-critical nonlinear Schrödinger equation associated with $\mathcal L_a=-Δ+a|x|^{-2}$. For nonnegative potentials, we extend the known finite-$p$ theory to the endpoint $L^1\to L^\infty$. For negative potentials in the global well-posedness range, set $σ=\frac12-\sqrt{\frac14+a}$. We obtain the free strong decay rate for $2<p<3/σ$ and the limiting Lorentz estimate from $L^{(3/σ)',1}$ to $L^{3/σ,\infty}$. The restriction $p<3/σ$ is sharp for strong Lebesgue decay.
